summary: Completed comprehensive testing of ManuelIA v2 backend APIs and frontend UI. Fixed critical bug in job polling (created_at field type mismatch). All backend APIs working (50/50 tests passed). Frontend mostly working (19/20 tests passed) with one minor toggle interaction issue.

fixed_bugs.issue: JobStatus.created_at validation error - field was float (time.time()) instead of ISO string
fixed_bugs.fix: Changed created_at from time.time() to datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
fixed_bugs.impact: Was blocking all manual generation job polling (500 error)

ui_bugs.issue: Toggle checkbox not clickable via Playwright (element not visible) - hidden input with styled div overlay
ui_bugs.note: Toggle is functional (API works), just a Playwright selector issue. Visual toggle div should have data-testid or be clickable.

passed_tests: Backend: Health check, signup, login, get me, AI clarify (multi-turn), manual generation with polling, list manuals, get manual, regenerate step, toggle public, get public manual (with/without auth), export PDF, usage stats, Stripe checkout URLs (subscription + credits), update preferences, delete all manuals

Frontend: Auth page render, login flow, dashboard stat cards, topbar badge with green dot, sidebar navigation (/create, /credits, /settings), settings page content (models, callout, toggles, danger zone), credits page (plans + packs), create wizard step 1 and step 2 transition
